body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two enemies within 4 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each is Distracted until the start of your next turn; choose one hit target to take 1 Psychic Damage.

surges.html: Each hit target's next spoken combat coordination is perceptible to you, without reading private thoughts, until the start of your next turn.
Deal 1 Psychic Damage to the second hit target.

rider.title: Strain - Assault
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, mark one hit target: you detect its space through ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn, but not through solid walls.
